For Prysm, the PR is currently under review (first pass of fixes following comments done). Should be merged on Monday hopefully 🤞 (However, this is validator custody **without** backfill.) do you have to backfill according to spec? ~~Hum, I don't think the spec states anything about backfill ATM.~~ Yes im just curious if a client randomizes its node id on each startup, then they gonna need to backfill like 10-15gb worth of blobs always? 😄 For this precise purpose, Prysm stops randomizing node id at restart from fulu. (Before, a new node ID was generated at every restart by default.) > As with the regular custody requirement, a node MUST backfill columns when syncing. In addition, when the validator custody requirement increases, due to an increase in the total balance of the attached validators, a node MUST backfill columns from the new custody groups. However, a node may wait to advertise a higher custody in its Metadata and ENR until backfilling is complete https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/dev/specs/fulu/das-core.md#validator-custody should take me 2 weeks from today, as i have some other commitments in peerdas worst case do you also stop randomizing node id? we have a flag you need to spin it up with that, 1 moment ``` netKeyFile* {. desc: "Source of network (secp256k1) private key file " & "(random|<path>)" defaultValue: "random", name: "netkey-file" .}: string netKeyInsecurePassword* {. desc: "Use pre-generated INSECURE password for network private key file" defaultValue: false, name: "insecure-netkey-password" .}: bool ``` would make it default tbh alright otherwise your users (and so are we) gonna be very cranky if we have to download tens of gig of blob subnets at each restart i'll still consult <@654267572107083777> if we would freeze it post fulu, as in stop randomizing. and follow up on this coming week you can randomize it as long as the next random number will also reuse the exact same subnets lmao well but then you will be mining for node ids at each restart? :))) exactly not a good idea Hey pandaops team, I'm curious where's the repo for `el_image: ethpandaops/geth:PeerDAS-7f6090b` for peerdas-devnet-5? Did we do any customization for it? cc: <@199561711278227457> <@412614104222531604> cc <@131476523050860545> currently I'm regarding the node ID randomization as a still good idea that peerdas unfortunately probably makes infeasible https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/1252403418941624532/1343963238693339229 Which CL clients allow setting the node key via config? Either cli flag or some file This would be useful for future devnets. So that we can control the column distribution a bit without having to create too many nodes just to cover all columns. Prysm: ``` --p2p-priv-key value The file containing the private key to use in communications with other peers. ``` If you don't use this flag, Prysm (on the `peerDAS` branch) will choose one private key randomly, and then will keep the same reboot after reboot. With this flag, you can set the private key you want to use. (And then, the nodeID is derived from this private key.)

excerpts.author: manunlp
excerpts.content:
Prysm:

```
--p2p-priv-key value The file containing the private key to use in communications with other peers.
```

If you don't use this flag, Prysm (on the `peerDAS` branch) will choose one private key randomly, and then will keep the same reboot after reboot.
With this flag, you can set the private key you want to use. (And then, the nodeID is derived from this private key.)
